description: This source file defines the ClientMapper class which handles conversion between Client entity objects and ClientDto data transfer objects, primarily for use in a Spring application context.

classes.name: ClientMapper
classes.description: A Spring component that maps Client entities to ClientDto objects and vice versa, facilitating data transfer and object conversion in the application.

methods.name: toDto
methods.description: Converts a Client entity object into a ClientDto object by copying relevant fields.

methods.name: toEntity
methods.description: Converts a ClientDto object back into a Client entity object, constructing associated entities as needed.
